metadata.title: Crap From The Past - September 21, 2012: Now we're up to 13 songs that all sound the same
metadata.description: A pop music radio show for people who already know plenty about pop music, hosted by Ron "Boogiemonster" Gerber and heard every Friday night from 10:30 to midnight on KFAI-FM, 90.3 FM Minneapolis, 106.7 FM St. Paul, and KFAI.org.
